name: flowstate
description: Write, test, and debug Flowstate Flowfiles from Claude Code: the flow MCP server, authoring skills, and a live validation pane.

flowBinary.title: flow binary
flowBinary.description: The flow executable the mod runs to validate Flowfiles.

validateOnEdit.title: Validate after edits
validateOnEdit.description: Run flow validate after Claude edits a Flowfile and tell the model what is wrong.

guardServerActions.title: Confirm server actions
guardServerActions.description: Ask before Claude runs a flow verb that changes a server (run, signal, cancel, terminate, schedule changes), naming the verb and the server address.

verifyBeforeDone.title: Remind to verify
verifyBeforeDone.description: Once per turn, remind Claude to run flow validate (or flow test, when a suite exists) before it finishes if it edited a Flowfile and none has passed since.
